methodology: Family is copied from the authoritative model.model_group reference and its digest-verified model-group document.
Version, format, parameters, sizes, and artifact variants are copied from each model-version document.
Source evidence is copied from each pinned source.repository and source.revision; artifact revisions and SHA-256 values are retained verbatim.

Capability facts are copied only from the accepted schema-2 model capability declarations in the exact model-version documents and their external evidence digest; absent declarations remain unknown. Recipe interfaces are not used to infer model support, and no recipe display names, slugs, or regex are used.
purpose: Pre-schema evidence and source mapping for the current model-version catalog. This is an evidence artifact, not a runtime or publication contract.
